title_cn: 亚洲股市因鹰派沃什基调而下跌，石油上涨：市场结束

title_cn: 大峡谷山洪造成至少 15 人失踪

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 31
title_cn: 8 月 31 日最新石油市场新闻和分析
summary: Oil rose as fresh fighting flared up in the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting risks to flows from the Middle East after months of conflict.

title: Shein Set for Long-Awaited Hong Kong IPO Debut (Correct)
title_cn: Shein 即将在期待已久的香港首次公开募股（正确）
summary: From a peak valuation of 100 billion dollars to a targeted debut at a fraction of that figure, ultra-fast fashion giant Shein is preparing for a long-awaited public listing. But as regulatory crackdowns close tax loopholes and squeeze profit margins, the digital retailer is being forced to radically remake its business model. Bloomberg’s Minmin Low reports from Hong Kong. (Corrects spelling of the company's name in the headline.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Taiwan’s Top Regulator Wants to Wean Taiwan’s Insurers Off US Dollar Dependence
title_cn: 台湾最高监管机构希望台湾保险公司摆脱对美元的依赖
summary: Peng Jin-lung, a former academic who now runs Taiwan’s powerful financial regulator, is taking aim at a decades-old investment model used by the island’s life insurance firms — one of the biggest pools of insurance capital in the world.

title: Trump’s Iran War Sets Test for Xi and Putin’s Security Club
title_cn: 特朗普的伊朗战争给习近平和普京的安全俱乐部带来考验
summary: President Donald Trump’s intensifying economic campaign against Iran is testing the limits of the security grouping Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin have spent years expanding as a counterweight to US power.

title: Japan’s NYK CEO on Alternative Routes Amid Iran War
title_cn: 日本邮船首席执行官谈伊朗战争期间的替代路线
summary: Japanese shipping giant NYK's head Takaya Soga in an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Shery Ahn discusses how the company is exploring alternative routes due to the conflict in the Middle East. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Australian Dollar’s Top Forecasters Say Winning Run Likely Over
title_cn: 澳元的顶级预测者表示，澳元获胜的可能性很大
summary: The Australian dollar’s two-month rally may be nearing a peak, with some of its top forecasters warning that bets on another central bank interest-rate hike have gone too far.

title: Bond Investors Wary After Warsh Speech Fuels Rate-Hike Wagers
title_cn: 沃什言论引发加息押注后债券投资者保持警惕
summary: Bond investors at firms including ABN AMRO Investment Solutions and Brandywine Global Investment Management are voicing skepticism about mounting speculation that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is poised to raise interest rates.

title: Bloomberg This Weekend 08/30/2026
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Space Network Co-Founder & COO Ross Hamilton, RUV Iceland Correspondent Ingólfur Sigfússon, ABC News State Department Reporter Shannon Kingston, Heritage Foundation Inst. for National Security & Foreign Policy Victoria Coates, CSIS Director of Economics Program Philip Luck, Illinois Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi, Unleash Prosperity Chairman and Co-founder Stephen Moore and  “Autokill” Author and Fmr. New York City Transit Commissioner Sam Schwartz. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: 尖！彭博社针对冒险者的每周新闻测验
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Krishnamoorthi Warns Iran War Weakens US in Asia
title_cn: 众议员克里希纳莫提警告伊朗战争削弱美国在亚洲的地位
summary: Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi (D) says the Iran war is depleting key US munitions and pulling military assets from the Indo Pacific, potentially weakening deterrence against China as concerns over Taiwan grow. While on Bloomberg This Weekend, the Illinois Democrat also criticized the administration’s trade fight with Canada and Venezuela oil policy while calling for more US assistance to Nepal following catastrophic flooding. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How YouTube Filmmakers Are Reshaping Hollywood’s Talent Pipeline
title_cn: YouTube 电影制片人如何重塑好莱坞的人才管道
summary: YouTube creators are turning online audiences into big-screen opportunities, with filmmakers like Alex Kister moving from DIY horror videos to studio deals. As platforms, distributors and FAST services open new paths to money and viewers, the creator boom is also flooding the market with content, making it easier to start but harder to win. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Investors Bet on a Hair Loss Treatment Boom
title_cn: 投资者押注脱发治疗热潮
summary: Drugmakers are developing a new generation of hair loss treatments, including lotions, pills and longer-lasting injections, targeting a US market where tens of millions of men and women experience pattern hair loss. Joining Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Equities Reporter Avalon Pernell says some treatments could seek approval and reach the market as soon as 2027, drawing investor interest in companies hoping to tap consumers already willing to spend heavily on hair restoration. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shein’s $100 Billion Valuation Falls to $26 Billion
title_cn: Shein 的 1000 亿美元估值跌至 260 亿美元
summary: Shein is heading toward a Hong Kong listing at a valuation of about $26.5 billion, roughly a quarter of its 2022 peak, after earlier efforts to list in New York and London ran into regulatory hurdles. Bloomberg News Consumer Finance Reporter Lisa Du is on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz and says the fast-fashion giant is pitching investors on expanding beyond its core brand by acquiring or partnering with other labels, even as geopolitical, regulatory and reputational risks weigh on its growth story. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Venezuela Oil Deal Raises Questions Over US Role
title_cn: 委内瑞拉石油协议引发对美国角色的质疑
summary: The Trump administration’s deal giving a US-led venture access to 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil could reshape the countries’ economic relationship, but questions remain over its political durability and whether it will provoke a backlash inside Venezuela. Former Deputy National Secuirty Advisor for Middle East Affairs and the Heritage Foundation's Victoria Coates is on Bloomberg This Weekend and argues the agreement could encourage US investment and restore Venezuela’s energy sector, but says economic development must ultimately be accompanied by political liberalization and self-determination. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Bulls Turn to Exotic Options, Spreads in ‘Orderly’ Rally
title_cn: 黄金多头转向奇异期权，价差“有序”反弹
summary: Gold bulls rejuvenated by the Treasury Department’s efforts to keep US borrowing costs in check are turning to exotic options and spreads to bet on higher bullion prices.

title: BTW: Headlines You Should See
title_cn: 顺便说一句：你应该看到的头条新闻
summary: Costco rotisserie chicken, marmots terrorizing hikers, and Starbucks dust problem: These are some of the headlines from this week that Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz think you should see. Watch, on Bloomberg This Weekend. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iceland Rejects Restarting EU Membership Talks
title_cn: 冰岛拒绝重启欧盟成员国谈判
summary: Icelandic voters rejected restarting EU accession talks, with opposition particularly strong outside Reykjavik as concerns over sovereignty, fisheries and agriculture outweighed arguments for closer European ties.  RÚV Iceland News Defense & Security Correspondent Ingólfur Sigfússon is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says says the result puts membership talks on hold and could shift attention toward Norway as Nordic countries reassess their relationships with Europe amid geopolitical uncertainty. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shein CEO’s Wealth Slumps $15 Billion After Whittled-Down IPO
title_cn: IPO 缩减后，Shein 首席执行官的财富缩水 150 亿美元
summary: Chinese fast-fashion business Shein Global Holdings Ltd. was once worth more than the parent companies of H&M and Zara, giving its reclusive boss Sky Xu a net worth of more than $23 billion.

summary: Markiplier believes GoPro cameras can revolutionize filmmaking

title: The Ternus Era At Apple Begins, But Cook Isn’t Leaving
title_cn: 苹果的 Ternus 时代开始了，但库克并没有离开
summary: Apple is getting a new CEO. John Ternus officially takes over from Tim Cook on September 1, and he has a lot on his plate to tackle. Mark Gurman explains what Ternus faces in this next chapter of the tech company (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Author Explores Cybersecurity Risks of Driverless Cars
title_cn: 作者探讨无人驾驶汽车的网络安全风险
summary: Former New York City Traffic Commissioner Sam Schwartz joins hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend and warns that the expansion of autonomous vehicles brings cybersecurity risks, including the possibility that bad actors could seize control of connected cars and use them as weapons. His new novel, Autokill, explores that threat while Schwartz argues that autonomous vehicles still have significant safety potential if companies provide greater transparency and governments prepare for emerging risks.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Google Maps Changes Lake Ontario Label to Lake America in US
title_cn: 谷歌地图将美国安大略湖标签更改为美洲湖
summary: Google Maps relabeled Lake Ontario as “Lake America” for users in the US, Alphabet Inc. announced, after President Donald Trump said he would rename the lake amid a trade spat with Canada.

title: John Ternus Management Team; Apple Watch Series 12; Foldable iPhone Apple Pencil
title_cn: 约翰·特纳斯管理团队； Apple Watch 系列 12；可折叠 iPhone 苹果铅笔
summary: Also: Apple experimented with a Pencil for the coming foldable iPhone.

title: G20 Faces Divide Over Debt, AI and Global Growth
title_cn: G20 在债务、人工智能和全球增长方面面临分歧
summary: G20 finance officials are gathering in North Carolina with sovereign debt, global imbalances and economic growth in focus, but CSIS Director of Economics Program Philip Luck joins Bloomberg This Weekend and says the US and its partners increasingly disagree over both the problems and how to address them. A separate technology meeting will bring Elon Musk, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and OpenAI’s Sam Altman into discussions over AI and emerging technologies as Washington pushes for a lighter regulatory framework. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: PetroChina First-Half Profit Rises 22% on Higher Oil Prices
title_cn: 油价上涨推动中石油上半年利润增长22%
summary: PetroChina Co. posted a 22% increase in first-half profit as a surge in global energy prices boosted upstream revenue at China’s biggest oil and gas producer.

title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
title_cn: 阿利科·丹格特的女儿加入继任计划
summary: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Algeria Sends Fighter Jets to Support Niger After Failed Mutiny
title_cn: 叛变失败后阿尔及利亚派遣战斗机支援尼日尔
summary: Algeria said it deployed four fighter jets to support the military rulers of neighboring Niger after a failed mutiny over the weekend.

title: Trump’s Venezuela Oil Grab Reprises Industry’s Neocolonial Past
title_cn: 特朗普对委内瑞拉石油的掠夺重演了工业界的新殖民主义过去
summary: President Donald Trump’s plan to seize direct control of Venezuela’s oil reserves is prompting warnings that the Latin American nation will become a modern-day resource colony akin to the so-called banana republics of a century ago —  something that could create long-term risks for oil companies operating there.

title: French Socialist Head Joins Race to Succeed President Macron
title_cn: 法国社会党领袖加入马克龙总统继位竞赛
summary: Olivier Faure, the general secretary of France’s center-left Socialist Party, joined a crowded field of candidates vying to succeed President Emmanuel Macron in next spring’s election.

title: Venezuela’s Maduro Resurfaces on Social Media Amid US Oil Deal
title_cn: 委内瑞拉马杜罗在美国石油协议中重新出现在社交媒体上
summary: Venezuela’s ousted President Nicolás Maduro resurfaced in a series of pictures posted Sunday on social media, just days after acting President Delcy Rodríguez inked a sweeping energy agreement with the United States.

title: Canada’s Ford Likens Trump Move to Saturday Night Live Skit
title_cn: 加拿大福特将特朗普比作《周六夜现场》短剧
summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford ridiculed President Donald Trump’s order changing the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America, while expressing optimism that Canada and the US would eventually overcome their differences on trade and tariffs.

title: Merz Says Far-Right Win in German State Would Put Off Investors
title_cn: 默茨称极右翼在德国获胜将令投资者望而却步
summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Germany’s eastern Saxony-Anhalt region will suffer economic damage if the far-right AfD party wins control of the state’s government next Sunday.

title: Trump Urges FCC to Probe Media Polling, Punish NBC Moderator
title_cn: 特朗普敦促 FCC 调查媒体民调并惩罚 NBC 主持人
summary: President Donald Trump stepped up his attacks against the media on Sunday with an admonition to the Federal Communications Commission to investigate polling used by news outlets and punish a prominent television news host.

title: Iceland Votes to Reject the EU as Fisheries Worry Prevails
title_cn: 由于渔业担忧盛行，冰岛投票拒绝欧盟
summary: Icelanders narrowly turned down reopening membership talks with the European Union in a divisive referendum, as concerns over retaining control of the island nation’s natural resources eclipsed the case for closer alignment with Europe.

title: Trump Ally Says Fed Should Hold Rates Steady
title_cn: 特朗普盟友称美联储应维持利率稳定
summary: Former Trump Senior Economic adviser Stephen Moore is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says inflation remains too high for the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, breaking with President Donald Trump’s repeated calls for lower borrowing costs and arguing the central bank should hold rates steady for now. Moore also warned hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz that elevated oil prices and the escalating US Canada trade fight pose risks to the economy and Republicans heading into the midterm elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: White House Exodus Poses New Challenge for Trump at Pivotal Time
title_cn: 白宫出走给关键时刻的特朗普带来新挑战
summary: President Donald Trump is entering a critical stretch of his second term with a slew of resignations among his senior staff, forcing him to rely on an even smaller circle of aides.

title: Zambia Opposition Leader Arrested on Treason Charge
title_cn: 赞比亚反对派领袖因叛国罪被捕
summary: Zambian police arrested and charged the country’s main opposition leader with treason, ramping up political tensions that have spiked after the copper-rich nation’s disputed August general election.

title: World Mostly Shrugs Off Bessent’s Iran Sanctions Warnings
title_cn: 世界大多对贝森特的伊朗制裁警告不屑一顾
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent began the week vowing an “economic onslaught” against Iran and its trading partners in a fresh bid to end the war. By the week’s end, countries with ties to Tehran had so far shrugged off the threat and analysts were left underwhelmed by the US actions.

title: Canada Pushes Back as US Trade Tensions Rise
title_cn: 美国贸易紧张局势升级，加拿大予以反击
summary: US Canada trade negotiations remain stalled as Prime Minister Mark Carney maintains a tougher stance against President Donald Trump and retaliatory Canadian tariffs approach. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason also discusses recent departures from Trump’s White House, including press secretary Karoline Leavitt, as the administration heads toward the midterm elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iceland Narrowly Rejects Reopening EU Entry Talks in Referendum
title_cn: 冰岛以微弱优势拒绝在公投中重新开启入盟谈判
summary: Icelanders rejected a reopening of membership talks with the European Union, the country’s national broadcaster said, in a referendum seen as a test of the bloc’s geopolitical appeal.

title: Burnham Moves to Defuse Crisis by Blocking Cop-Killers’ Release
title_cn: 伯纳姆通过阻止释放警察杀手来化解危机
summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham moved to head off a political crisis by blocking more criminals from benefiting from early release from prison, including two men convicted for the death of a policeman in 2019.

title: Malaysia Raises Subsidized Fuel Quotas as PM Anwar Courts Voters
title_cn: 马来西亚提高燃油补贴配额，安瓦尔总理吸引选民
summary: Malaysia will restore subsidized fuel quotas to previous levels despite elevated energy prices, as Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to ease cost-of-living pressures and shore up support after recent electoral setbacks.

title: UK Asylum System Tests Burnham’s Push for More Public Control
title_cn: 英国庇护制度考验伯纳姆推动更多公共控制的努力
summary: Andy Burnham wants to row back the era of private companies running public services. Britain’s asylum system presents a difficult target.

title: South Korea’s Lee Nominates New Finance, Defense Ministers
title_cn: 韩国李明博提名新任财政部长和国防部长
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung elevated a vice finance minister to the country’s top economic post and named a new defense minister in a Cabinet reshuffle to revive growth and accelerate investment.

title: Far-Right Party Wins Closely Watched Western Australia Vote
title_cn: 极右翼政党赢得备受关注的西澳大利亚州投票
summary: The far-right One Nation party has secured its first lower house seat in the state parliament of Western Australia, defeating the ruling Labor Party to win a special election.
